mapper.select: SELECT a.attendance_no AS attendanceNo , a.course_no AS courseNo , a.student_user_no AS studentUserNo , a.week_no AS weekNo , a.attendance_status AS attendanceStatus FROM tb_attendance a WHERE a.course_no = #{courseNo} AND a.student_user_no = #{studentUserNo} ORDER BY a.week_no ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attendanceCount , SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount , SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCount , ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1 ) AS attendanceRate FROM tb_attendance WHERE course_no = #{courseNo} AND student_user_no = #{studentUserNo}
